profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Raya
profile.summary:
As a software engineer, one of my core strengths lies in my ability to translate requirements into actionable solutions, ensuring that what is needed is effectively built. I excel in offering innovative problem-solving approaches while appreciating diverse viewpoints, making me well-suited for collaborative, team-oriented environments.

I've been building React front-end applications / developing backend API's on production for about 4 years now. I love building full stack personal applications to continue honing my skills, so most of my passion/side projects include (but are not limited to) MERN apps surrounding some of my favorite hobbies: wellness, reading, cooking and outdoor activities.

Skills: React, Javascript/Typescript, Node.js, Ruby, Git, Redux, Jest, TailwindCSS, ES6, PostgreSQL

https://camillecodes.com/

positions.title: Senior Frontend Developer
positions.description:
• Lead developer responsible for redesign, development and deployment of robust and scalable front-end solutions for B2B financing applications and customer tools 
• Architect a mono-repository to consolidate micro-frontend UIs into a new Next.js/Typescript application, using Docker, React-query, TailwindCSS, and Postgres
• Provide technical support to customers in Ruby on Rails monolith application

positions.title: Frontend Web Developer
positions.description:
• Built, managed, and deployed new company analytics dashboard and credit portfolio management UI with real-time metric tracking using React, Redux, Postgres, Typesense, Docker and Tailwind
• Migrated pages from a Ruby on Rails monolith to React micro-frontends
• Architect new UI and lead Plaid integration for automated customer bank validation

positions.title: Director of Client Success & Support
positions.description:
• Ensured sold KPIs exceed objectives, while driving incremental revenue via proactive upselling
• Cross-collaborate with integrations, product, and engineering teams to implement new product features, ERP integrations, and Tableau reporting tools

positions.title: Customer Success Manager
positions.description:
• Manage a portfolio of the top 85 small business and enterprise fashion brands in Los Angeles, an upward of $800k, maintaining over a 90% yearly retention rate 
• Plan, launch, and optimize new team-wide onboarding project; included new decks, scripts, external resources, and timeline detail; increased brand adoption by 10%

positions.title: Sales Team Lead
positions.description:
• Manage daily activities and lead generation performance of a team of 10 account managers
• Developed new training resources which increased sales team performance by 15%
• Partner with Marketing Director to create email marketing content resulting in 10% more inbound leads

positions.title: Senior Account Manager
positions.description:
• Increased adoption in key markets by 10% by pitching and executing remote installations of Brighter’s scheduling and patient communications software
• Consistently delivered 105% of target, setting and holding the company wide record
• Led optimization calls with all key accounts while maintaining full book of business (80+ accounts)
• Analyzed data and metrics to boost overall performance and exceed target sales goals

volunteerExperiences.description:
In an effort to alleviate poverty and grow education in an underprivileged community, I taught the elementary youth of the community essential Math, English, and Life skills while empowering and encouraging them to be leaders.

•	Educated underprivileged groups of students from 3rd grade to 6th grade, focusing on Mathematic skills and English grammar and literature skills
•	Led scholar discussions about the importance of education across the world
•	Visited prominent educational facilities around the city of Cape Town and presented information about education and health care

• Lead scholar discussions about the history and success of the medical fields across the world

• Visited prominent medical facilities in Australia that focused on underprivileged patient care

• Presented collection of scholar research to board of program directors at the end of the program
